frontend.description: Frontend to use for scanning: libsane-perl, scanimage, or scanadf.

tmp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files; empty means use system $TMPDIR.

tmp_compression.description: Compression to apply to temporary files: none or lzw.

default_output_dir.description: Default directory for saving exported files; empty means home.

default_filename.description: Default filename pattern for PDF/DjVu exports (supports strftime + %Da, %De, %Dt).

allow_batch_flatbed.description: Allow batch scanning from flatbed scanners (workaround for scanners without ADF).

force_new_job_between_pages.description: Force new scan job between pages (for scanners with flaky 'out of documents' signals).

show_advanced_options.description: Show advanced SANE options in scan dialog.

reload_triggers.description: Comma-separated SANE options that trigger a full reload when changed.

ocr_engine.description: OCR engine to use: tesseract, gocr, or cuneiform. Empty disables OCR.

ocr_lang.description: Language codes for OCR (space-separated, passed as '-l' to OCR tools).

unpaper_path.description: Path to unpaper executable; empty disables unpaper.

default_resolution.description: Default resolution (PPI) in scan dialog (0 = auto).

default_mode.description: Default scanning mode: color, gray, or lineart.

default_paper_size.description: Default paper size: a4, letter, etc.

default_source.description: Default document source: flatbed, adf, or automatic.

device.description: Device URI to use (e.g. 'escl:http://scanner.local'); empty auto-detects.

device_blacklist.description: List of device URIs (regex) to ignore during device discovery.

metadata_author.description: Author name for embedded PDF/DjVu metadata.

custom_tools.description: User-defined tools with command templates (%i, %o, %r placeholders). Each item has name and cmd fields.
